notes.title: The New Video Suite 2024 Is Here to Save the Day!

- [b]Revamped timeline[/b]
The new timeline is now clearer and more streamlined. Get your projects done faster and have more fun with any types of videos.

 - [b]Frame-precise cuts in a click[/b]
Give your videos a sharper look with the new video-cutting tool. Easily make precise cuts and create eye-catching montages.

Now each overlay effect has 13 blending modes to choose from. Try each of them  and pick the one that fits your video perfectly.

Get next-level color correction with the same simplicity. Boost colors in a snap and make more viewers fall in love with your videos.

Give what you’ve shot this summer a serious facelift and make your vids’ resolution 8 times higher.

notes.title: Meet the all-new Video Suite 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Celebrate the new Movavi Video Suite with AI superpowers! [/b]
Light up your most recent adventures to make them outshine that summer sun!
[h3]Highlights
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]AI background removal
[/b]Use the power of the AI to instantly swap backgrounds in your vacation videos with no green screens. Drop in a new vibrant scene and get ready for an avalanche of likes on TikTok!
[*] [b]AI noise removal
 [/b]Cut through the noise if you partied hard this summer! Remove car, wind, and other uncool sounds from your videos with this new AI-driven audio denoiser.
[*] [b]Direct upload to TikTok
[/b]Get on the For You page this fall with direct sharing to TikTok. Upload your sunny vids straight from the app and collect tons of views and likes much faster!
[*] [b]AI upscaling
 [/b]Give what you’ve shot this summer a serious facelift, making your vids’ resolution 8 times better. Treat your followers to more eye candy and show them – in every detail – how hot and sunny it all was!
[*] [b]Drawing shapes on video
[/b]Add tidy-looking pointers and other shapes in the middle of your recordings. Guide the viewers’ attention to the parts you want to highlight and get your message across in a most impactful way.
[*] [b]Scrolling screenshots
[/b]No need to take endless screenshots anymore. Take scrolling screenshots to capture content that doesn't fit on the screen.
[*] [b]New music[/b]. 
 We've expanded our collection of tracks. Now your videos will resonate in a new way.
[*] [b]New trendy frames. 
 [/b]Draw attention to the most action-packed moments in your game
[*][b]Fresh DLC effects sets. [/b]
Choose from a vast collection of outros and intro videos, titles, stickers, transitions, and backgrounds to create engaging and thrilling Let’s Plays for social networks and video sharing platforms[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2171290/extras/dlc_effects.png?t=1668616643[/img]
